mechanism: Praziquantel is metabolized by CYP450 enzymes while vancomycin has minimal hepatic metabolism; concurrent use may increase praziquantel levels in patients with hepatic impairment or reduced clearance, and both drugs can cause CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased praziquantel adverse effects (dizziness, headache) and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of vancomycin; no dose adjustment typically required in patients with normal hepatic function.
